_about: Site-side suppressions of dictionary highlights that would mislabel a word (SITE_CHANGELOG_AND_TASKS.md C2). Each entry turns one surface form into plain text in one chapter (or '*' for every chapter); it never adds or changes a gloss. Every entry is reported to the KB owner in CONTENT_TRACE.md (K20) so the fix can move into dictionary/ambiguous_forms.md, after which it is removed here.
